A nice little game, the game physics aren't revolutionary or anything, but it plays really well. The content is pretty bare bones, the bike customization is not too bad and there's a good selection of bikes to pick from, but you cannot customize your riders appearance any way you want. The modes of play is bare bones as well, only having campaign mode and that's it, the game lacks a dedicated single session or score attack mode like in Tony Hawks Pro Skater so you can go for the best score without secondary goals or anything. 

Still a fun game but if the game added:
- Rider Customization
- Score Attack mode
- Custom trick loadouts
Then it would be great!

I know, I only played 2 hours, but I already requested a refund; let me explain:

DO I RECOMMEND THIS GAME ?

The quick answer would be yes, it is a fun game and it's about bikes so why not ?
However they are several things that seemed wacky to me,especially since it's a 2-years old game now, finished etc...
First of all, the speed system is very random. It is too hard to get the exact amout of speed to pass through some jumps andtrying 20 times is more like a pain in the ananass than a real pleasure.

After the 2 first chapters which are very cool because a bit easy so you just focus on fun and tricks, you are hit by this random speed problem. The problem is that there is only 2 gamemodes, so if you don't pass all the stars or most of them you wont unlock the rest of the content that is also what you paid. I wish there was an infinite mode, or other modes or even the liberty of riding how you want. 

If they really want to improve the game, I would suggest to either fix that speed/pump mecanic or make the levels more forgiving.

I know at first sight this comment might appear immature but it's just my point of view. Maybe it's just not a game for me, which is sad because I really was interested.

Been loving the game so far so I can already give it a thumbs up! I previously played Pumped BMX 2 and although also pretty fun, I'm having a greater time with Shred 2. There's more variety in the tracks and challenges, although so less variety in the tricks, Pumped BMX 2 has tricks in all joystick directions + 2 modifiers, so 24 tricks overall I believe while in Shred 2 only 8 are possible (plus a cool trick later unlocked in the game [spoiler]180[/spoiler].  The difficulty curve is pretty good and challenges get tricky but always fun, not grindy. There seems to be plenty of content to keep you busy, I estimate some 6-10 hours to complete all challenges.
Sam's voice overs are really funny, the character model is pretty good, track design is amazing... I love that new updates and content are still being published.
